headers: Casualty Assessment: Vital Signs, Capillary Refill and Neurological Assessment

rows: To refresh the DMT’s fading skill in Casualty Assessment

The participants will be able to discuss how to take vital signs (blood pressure, temperature, pulse and respiration rate), capillary refill and perform neurological assessment. ☐ Discuss essential body functions: heartbeat, breathing rate, temperature and blood pressure ☐ Discuss how to perform and demonstrate neurological assessment ☐ Familiarise with the equipment involved in these assessments. ☐ Practical assessment
BP apparatus, thermometer, reflex hammer Lecture hand-outs and sample photos and videos.

1st 10 minutes - Presentation of the above topics by the Medic through lectures hand-outs. Showing sample photos and instructional videos. 2nd 10 minutes - Demonstration on how to apply the above topics. 3rd 20 minutes - Guided Practice and Independent Practice by the participants and Group Activities.

slides.title: Drill 4 Overview: Casualty Assessment - Training IDs 2.1-2.6
content: Prerequisite: Must complete Drill 3 (Training IDs 1.8-1.10) first
This drill covers 6 sequential training scenarios:
Each scenario must be completed before proceeding to the next.

slides.title: Training ID 2.1: Blood Pressure Assessment
content: • Demonstrate proper blood pressure measurement technique
• Recognize normal and abnormal BP ranges
• Proper cuff size selection and placement

slides.title: Training ID 2.3: Pulse Assessment
content: • Locate and palpate various pulse points
• Assess pulse rate, rhythm, and quality
• Radial, carotid, and other pulse sites
• Normal pulse rates by age group

slides.title: Training ID 2.4: Respiration Assessment
content: • Assess respiratory rate, depth, and pattern

slides.title: Training ID 2.5: Capillary Refill Assessment
content: • Interpret refill times and their significance
• Use results to assess perfusion status
• Proper technique for nail bed compression

slides.title: Training ID 2.6: Neurological Assessment
content: • Assess level of consciousness using AVPU scale

slides.title: Drill 4 Assessment: Training IDs 2.1-2.6
content: Red: Does not meet minimum expectations.
Amber: Meets and demonstrates the basic requirements.
Green: Meets and demonstrates a thorough understanding.
• Show competency in all 6 assessment techniques
All 6 training scenarios (2.1-2.6) must be completed successfully before proceeding to Drill 5.
